description: Where to stay for a major UAE event, in one call: hotels grouped by distance to the venue (at the venue, nearby, rest of the city), each with live all-in prices for the event's own dates, whether rooms were found, refundability and a link that opens the hotel on those dates. Use it for questions like 'best hotels for the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix / F1', 'where to stay near Yas Marina Circuit' or 'is the F1 weekend sold out'. Currently supports: abu-dhabi-f1-2026 (Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, Yas Marina Circuit, 3-7 December 2026). Also returns Fostay's editorial advice for the event and when to book. To book a hotel, pass its hotel_id and an offer from get_live_rates to prepare_booking.

currency.description: Currency to quote in (AED, INR, EUR, AUD, SGD, NZD). Defaults to the hotel's home currency: INR for Goa, AED for Dubai and Abu Dhabi. The price quoted is the price charged.

event.description: Event to rank hotels for (default: abu-dhabi-f1-2026)

name: event_stays
title: Hotels for a major event, ranked by distance to the venue
